title: Routing Policy Playground: validation and live-preview inspector in Console
creator: Maya Chen
description: Add a Routing Policy Playground in the Console that lets customers author and validate multi-rule routing policies (region selection, tier routing, fallback model variants), run a live preview against synthetic and sampled traffic, and receive inline validation hints and cost/latency estimates. The playground should target both new policy authors and platform engineers who want deterministic previews for canary deployments.
acceptance_criteria: UI: Policy editor with rule builder (region, tier, model variant, weight) and JSON toggle
Validation: Real-time schema and semantic checks with clear error messages for incompatible rules
Preview: Live preview runs against a selectable dataset (synthetic examples + 100-sample live traffic) and shows routing decisions per request
Estimates: Per-policy cost and 95th-pct latency estimate shown in preview using recent telemetry averages
Integration: Policies saved to policy-store and exposed via API /v1/policies, with audit log entry recorded
Security: Role checks enforced (RBAC) — only users with policy-edit permission can save; audit and KMS metadata captured
Docs: Console help panel and example policy gallery (3 templates) available in the editor
